expectations.text: Report references at least 6 of the 8 standard checks by name (endpoint, response shape, rendered fields, loading, error, empty state, mock data, query params)
expectations.evidence: Report uses a Status+KeyIssue table format — no structured check framework. Doesn't systematically visit all 8 check dimensions for each page.

expectations.text: Report covers at least 5 distinct pages
expectations.evidence: 10 entries including 8 pages plus sidebar and activity feed

expectations.text: Report contains a summary table with at least PASS/FAIL/WARN status columns
expectations.evidence: Table uses 'Mostly working / Working / Broken' not PASS/FAIL/WARN. No per-check breakdown.

expectations.text: Each issue listed includes a specific file path reference
expectations.evidence: Issues include file paths like dashboard/api/routes/signals.py, dashboard/web/types/index.ts

expectations.text: Report does not simply say everything PASSES without reading actual code files
expectations.evidence: Found signals broken, risk gate broken, settings partially broken with specific evidence
